title: Fused slab allocator + eviction coordinator to reduce KV block churn and pin thrash
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: high tail latency and memory churn observed under mixed-size KV cache workloads (chat + long-context completion). This PR introduces a fused slab allocator that colocates small and medium KV blocks into size classes and an eviction coordinator that batches pin/unpin operations to avoid reactive reshuffle storms. Key goals: reduce lock contention in the block manager, lower KV cache GC pressure, and stabilize p95/p99 latency under bursty workloads. Summary of changes: fused slab allocator implementation with three size classes (64B, 512B, 4KB) and a compacting fastpath; eviction coordinator that aggregates release events per shard and applies hysteresis before issuing reclaim; new background coalescer that merges adjacent free blocks within a slab when fragmentation exceeds a threshold; metrics and tracing for block lifecycle (alloc/evict/pin/unpin); unit and integration tests (deterministic allocator tests + perf bench harness changes). Performance: in microbench synthetic hotset test (50% hot keys, 1000 concurrent clients), observed ~13% throughput improvement, 9-15% reduction in p95 and p99 latency across model serving pipelines, and ~22% reduction in allocation-related GC cycles on a 8-GPU Dedicated node profile. Backwards-compatibility: allocator is opt-in under a feature flag (kv_fused_slab) default-enabled for canary runtime only; semantics for pinned entries unchanged. Risks: subtle correctness around concurrent pin/unpin ordering was mitigated with a pin-seq counter and test harness scenarios. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked and reviewed - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration perf test - [x] Feature flag gated - [x] Metrics + dashboards updated - [x] Migration + rollback plan documented
commits: 6 commits: feat(kv): add fused slab allocator with size classes; feat(kv): add eviction coordinator and batching; perf(kv): add background coalescer and fastpath; test(kv): deterministic allocator tests + hotset perf harness; docs: rollout + migration notes; fix(kv): concurrency edgecase for pin-seq ordering
review_thread: Priya: 'Can you justify size-class choices and thresholds?'; Maya: 'We measured hot key size distribution and 64/512/4K covers ~88% of allocations; thresholds are tunable via config and documented in design.md'; Diego: 'Eviction coordinator looks good but ensure backpressure doesn't delay critical frees' -> Maya: 'Coordinator uses shard-level hysteresis and emits metrics; reduced batch window to 10ms under high pressure; added unit test to validate timely reclaim'; Liam: 'Please add a regression test for large contiguous allocations to ensure coalescer does not break alignment' -> Maya: 'Added alignment-preserving coalescer test and small note in docs'; CI: initial linux-x86 unit failed on race detector (flaky test) -> fix: added stronger pin-seq test + rerun -> CI passed
release_notes: Improves KV cache behavior with a new fused slab allocator and eviction coordinator; reduces tail latency and memory churn under mixed-size workloads; feature-flag gated canary rollout; no user-facing API changes
